summary: Date/location reconciliation for OCHA/NAD road-stoning injury components.

resolution_notes: Unresolved-first recheck preserved the prior reconciliation: Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat/Munir Ahmed Abdullah Mur is already canonical as ILPV-2023-0323. NAD daily/monthly place the Deir Istiya/Muhammad Sami Abu Rabi incident on Mar. 26. Newly recovered PSNA/Daily Blog reproductions also place it on Mar. 26 and identify Abu Rabi, but appear derivative of Palestinian monitoring and do not independently map OCHA's separate aggregate Mar. 27 road-stoning injury to Deir Istiya. Preserve Unresolved rather than normalize the date or merge components by guesswork.
